description: Create a party gift wishlist. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_wishlist_item. OpenAPI: createWishlist.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en-US, sv, de. Optional; amazon.com always returns English.

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront for the end user, e.g. amazon.com (US, English, tag sw-julklappsspel-20) or amazon.se (Sweden, tag sw-julklappsspel-21). Optional: if omitted, en-US requests get amazon.com and everything else amazon.se. Never errors on a missing store.

name: create_wishlist
title: Create wishlist
